verdicts.reason: A is a clean top-to-bottom stack: eyebrow, headline, subline, then the can inside its lavender circle (bleeding off the right edge as in the original), then the CTA and legal. The only flaw is a slightly large empty gap between the circle and the Shop Sale button. B pushes the eyebrow and the oversized '20% off' headline over the top-right circle, so the text and graphic collide. Its type crowds both side edges, the can floats detached from its circle in an empty lower half, and the legal line runs almost edge to edge.
